name: Sugammadex
halfLifeSource: FDA label for sugammadex sodium injection (sugammadex; Bridion generic), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — t½ ≈ 2 hours
halfLifeNotes: Adult anesthetized patients with normal renal function, IV dosing; renally excreted unchanged, so half-life extends to 4, 6, and 19 hours in mild, moderate, and severe renal impairment.
